博文更新计划与路线图 引言 近期安排 闲话少叙，简单说一下最近以及接下来的更新安排。距离 10 月初（也就是国庆），刚刚好还有两个半月。这段时间内我会把剩下的 AI 意译补丁全部做完，估计还有四五十个。
博客路线图（Roadmap） 补丁制作计划 遗漏补丁提醒机制 🔔 之前答应一些水友制作的补丁，因为时间隔得久，我自己也快忘记了。如果你的游戏补丁还没做，或者你有想做的，都可以在 TG 群 或 GitHub 评论区 留言提醒我。
💡 小提醒：我制作补丁不是严格按列表顺序来的，想到哪个就做哪个。所以如果没有提醒，刚好我又遗漏了，那这个补丁可能真的就会被遗忘啦。
7月中旬至月底 取消强制订阅制 🔓 接下来这段时间的大部分补丁，就不再添加订阅限制了，都会直接公开发布。 主要原因是订阅制流程太繁琐：每次发布除了写文章、Push，还得去爱发电开帖子、贴链接，一个星期后还得再修改博文公开…… 真的太占时间。
当然，如果遇到极其麻烦、文本量大、耗时久的游戏，可能还是会考虑加一下订阅制。毕竟制作也需要精力，有条件的水友可以投喂支持一下，没条件捧个人场也行。
7月底 🎮 Unity 引擎汉化教程 不需要编程基础。基本流程：安装工具 -> 配置环境 -> 调用 API -> 实现游戏内实时翻译。 过程会尽量做到通俗易懂，即使完全不懂代码也能跟着图文搞定。这篇教程原本计划 5 月底就写，最近补丁太多一直没抽出空。 10月初 💻 Ren'Py 引擎汉化教程 这个会稍微复杂点，需要一定的代码基础。加上不同作者的代码习惯差异非常大，有些写法简直“反人类”，所以这部分硬骨头会放到十月之后慢慢整理。 10月之后 佛系更新与简润权衡 🎣 10 月之后的博客整体会轻松不少，更新频率会降低。 后续还是会做一些简润补丁（我自己常玩的游戏），但其他大部分游戏不会投入大量时间搞精润了。毕竟产出比例在那：打磨一个简润的时间，够做四五个 AI 意译补丁了。与其花大量时间制作少量高质量补丁，不如把汉化教程整理出来，让大家自己掌握汉化方法，授人以鱼不如授人以渔。 关于联系方式（新增绿泡泡） 考虑到一部分水友没有 GitHub 或 Telegram，这里提供一个绿泡泡联系方式。我不怎么玩企鹅（QQ），主要是企鹅信息不通知，绿泡泡提醒比较及时。毕竟我的小破站已经进小黑屋了，音符上又不能发图片，大家反馈 bug 或推荐游戏发截图，绿泡泡会方便些。

高性价比推荐：魔戒（Mojie） 这个梯子我已经用了好多年了，基本没见过它跑路。最大特点是按流量计费，且不限制到期时间。

且玩且珍惜 引言 先说结论 先说结论吧：且玩且珍惜。
按照目前的情况来看，大概到了今年 10月1日国庆节之后，博客的更新频率会明显降低，正式进入一个半停更状态。为什么会这样？主要还是因为时间和精力实在难以支撑了。
心路历程与停更原因 最初的起点 帮看不懂英文的水友 🌍 为什么最开始会做这些补丁？最初的原因很简单：帮一些看不懂英文的水友而已。
以前在抖音直播时，大家总说没资源、看不懂。想着既然自己手里跑了上百个游戏，就顺手做成补丁发出来吧。也很感谢这些水友的陪伴，因为这段经历，我慢慢学会了 Python、Java、游戏文件结构、AI 部署以及 GitHub 的各种玩法。从某种意义上来讲，这段经历是值得的。
博客一周年 五个月七八十个补丁 📦 现在距离博客一周年（也就是国庆节）其实已经不远了。从今年2、3月份到现在，5个月的时间里我已经累计制作了超过七八十个补丁。这得益于年初我用 AI 跑了上百个游戏。目前手里还剩下大概三四十个存货，接下来会尽量把存货清空。
关于汉化标准：平心而论，大家玩这些难登大雅的“下九流”视觉小说，不就是冲着 CG 来的吗？只要剧情能看懂，CG 能看到，不就 OK 了？当然，萝卜青菜各有所爱，有人希望达到官中水准，但我确实精力有限。
精力的耗尽 为什么不继续做精润？ ⚠️ 肯定有人会问：剩下的时间把之前做好的拿出来做简润或精润不行吗？
大家可能不知道，做 AI 初版补丁和做人工简润/精润，完全是两个维度的概念。简润不能像做初版那样用 Python 脚本统一名词就完事，它需要人工一句句去检索。遇到网络问题、幻觉问题，消耗的资源巨大。文本量少需两三天，多则半个月。 如果是精润，需要跑 6 次、9 次甚至更多次 AI，成本呈指数级上升。哪怕烧再多 Token，Agent 依然有幻觉，最后还得人工修。Token 没了，精力没了，时间也没了。付出与收入真的一点都不成正比。
闲言碎语 争议与“圈米”的委屈 💔 一直有人在背后吐槽我汉化质量不好，甚至说我在“圈米”。这是最让我难绷的。
我开爱发电两年了，收到的打赏总共只有两三千块。说句不好听的，连跑 AI 烧的电费和 Token 本金都没回本！如果单纯为了赚钱，我根本坚持不到今天。 以前闲下来可以出去走走、骑骑车，现在每天工作之余还要学代码、修 Bug，还要承受莫名其妙的阴阳怪气。我已经在博客里叠好甲了，我做意译补丁只是为了帮人，我自己根本没时间玩。我真不欠你们的，最初的热情已经被消磨得差不多了。
10月之后 佛系维护，避开节奏 🍂 10月初存货清完后，就能顺利撒花完结，进入半停更。
以后我不可能再第一时间去做热门游戏的 AI 补丁了。一方面是有大佬在做精翻，我没必要去献丑；另一方面也是为了避免不必要的误会和节奏（懂异世界天堂那波节奏的水友应该都懂）。多一事不如少一事。
结语 一路走下来，博客从最初只有七八个补丁，到现在积累了上百个，其实已经远超我当初的想象了。 最后，感谢一直支持我、愿意使用补丁、积极反馈问题和提出意见的真实水友们。无论如何，且玩且珍惜，感谢大家的一路陪伴！
title: 且玩且珍惜

落谦酱便利贴 PS 顶级神作，极致细腻的文笔配上极端的剧情，如同水火相容，总结四个字，不玩白瞎。 博文更新日志 2026.08.01 · 12:00 Chapter 4 - Update 7 EA AI意译汉化补丁——DeepSeek-V4-Flash——Ch.4 Up.7 EA 2026.08.01 · 20:00 Chapter 4 - Update 7 EA AI意译汉化补丁——DeepSeek-V3——Ch.4 Up.7 EA 关于汉化补丁 AI模型：DeepSeek-V3 翻译作者：落谦 制作日期：2026-08-01 PS：由于AI会出现幻觉，那么文本上下文中，偶尔会出现人名翻译误差、中英文夹杂、以及突兀文风的句子。目前落谦也只能统一主要角色的人名，但难免还是会有个别遗漏，毕竟落谦只有一个人，时间和精力确实有限。至于一些小名、昵称、缩写称呼、称谓、地点、事件，以及专有名词，还有类似sister、brother这种一词多义的单词，则需要人工边玩边修正。当然，如果在统一主要角色人名时，发现了相关专有名词，也会顺手统一一下。还请大家多多谅解，总之不妨碍游玩，如果介意，还请勿玩。 免死金牌：落谦的汉化补丁，无论是AI意译版本还是逐句意译版本，都远不及原文或其他大佬的汉化版本。与其他汉化大佬不同，落谦并非为了为爱发电，而是纯粹希望提升文笔，所以会加入更多文化色彩，比如网络热梗？古诗词？谚语？俗语？网文小说梗？等等？还请高抬贵手，别再阴阳怪气我了。 落谦酱点评 游戏预览图 素图 DOWNLOAD（汉化补丁） Chapter 4 - Update 7 EA PS必看 先说个事儿啊，这次更新的速度比较慢，因为我家早上电路烧了导致停电，一直搞到10点钟才修好。我昨天本来1点多就早早睡了，结果因为停电没空调，6点多直接被热醒了，我操！
然后汉化这块怎么说呢，我本来试着用Deepseek V3去跑（用的是硅基流动，因为官网已经没V3了），结果发现一直请求失败，被限制了。所以我就用了昨天刚发布的Deepseek-V4-Flash正式版。之前我用过它的预览版，跑出来的效果差强人意，但是这次用正式版感觉还行，跑得挺快的。这次文本更新量比较大，原本用V3可能要跑一个小时，花费两块半；用了V4Flash跑得挺快，大概就花了二三十分钟，才3毛钱，还是比较便宜的。这模型比较屌，毕竟昨天刚发布，一群搞测试的都在吹，所以我就先拿来用一下。如果大家觉得这版质量跑得不好，我们晚上等硅基流动没那么挤了，再跑一个V3版本的。
总之目前就这样子。其实说实话，我是不太想制作这个游戏的，为什么呢？因为游戏比较热门，有很多人第一时间就跑了AI，甚至有大佬做了精翻，我也不想去献丑。但是有好几位水友一直让我跑这个，他们也没有别的资源，只能拿我的。我想了想，不做的话确实挺不厚道的，所以就帮他们做一下吧。
但是我每次做这种热门游戏，都会被人喷。有的人就说：“你他妈的，你自己都不玩，那跑出来干嘛呢？卧槽！有bug不修，有幻觉不修……”还要抓着我一顿喷。你说遇到这种搞我心态、一直阴阳怪气的，我是真不想弄这些。你们看我每次在博客更新的都是一些玩的人比较少的冷门游戏，反倒没人喷我，因为他们不玩呗，基本都是真正想玩的水友在玩。
还有就是关于之前4.6版本的肖恩模组，这次肖恩模组还没更新，等更新之后我们再把剩下的补上吧。
所以有问题大家可以正常反馈。但你要是他妈的喷我，那我就不做！你越喷我越不做，就这样子吧！

He struggles to communicate with people, a trait exacerbated by the domineering, tense, and rule-bound nature of his “landlady”, Ariana Caldwell. Stemming from a trauma in her early years, Ariana tries to maintain a tight grip on Aaron, leading him to become even more introverted. To escape from Ariana’s overbearing presence, Aaron immerses himself in computers and starts working on an artificial intelligence he created. Spoiler Ariana sustains her life as a successful realtor. Despite her powerful exterior, she has a low tolerance for alcohol. When she drinks, she undergoes a complete transformation, becoming affectionate, tolerant, playful, and romantic. Occasionally, the effects of alcohol make her doze off on the sofa or the table, and Aaron carries her to her room. For Aaron, dealing with the two faces of Ariana is challenging. While her dominant and tense demeanor shapes his life, her intoxicated self exhibits the loving character he yearns for. This complexity in their relationship and his feelings towards her become even more intricate as the artificial intelligence he created starts pushing its limits and exhibiting unpredictable behaviors. content:
爱发电 整体概况 每月汇总 2026年6月 2026年5月 2026年4月 2026年3月 2026年2月 2026年1月 2025年12月 2025年11月 2025年10月 2025年9月 2025年8月 2025年7月 2025年6月 2025年5月 2025年4月 2025年3月 2025年2月 2025年1月 2024年12月 爱赞助 整体概况 杂谈 感谢 由衷感谢以上所有投喂过的水友啊！特别感谢！虽然钱财不多，但是心意满满。落谦也不会辜负大家的诚意，后续会尽量为大家更新的，哈哈。
落谦 敬上
2026年7月1日 碎碎念：那些不得不吐的槽 感谢完了，顺便来吐个槽吧。怎么说呢，开爱发电也有两年半了（真没玩梗，哈哈），有些压在心里的陈年旧账，干脆借这个机会敞开说了。
关于“圈米”的无稽之谈 圈内总有人阴阳怪气，说我“圈米”肯定圈得盆满钵满了：在音符那么大的流量，跑到 B 站也有几万播放，肯定月入过万了。
说真的，看到这些话我已经无语了。大家投喂我两年半，总共也就两三千块。这笔钱，连我跑 AI 烧掉的本金都没收回来，更别提搭进去的人工、时间以及其他乱七八糟的精力了。说得好听叫投喂，在他们嘴里就是圈米。
看到这些阴阳怪气，我无数次想过直接停更。但回头看看手里那百来个跑好的 AI 文本，跑都跑了，半途而废挺可惜的，所以还是硬着头皮继续做。该做补丁做补丁，该修 Bug 修 Bug，写完博文上传后基本就不管了——因为我每天光搞这些都要两三个小时，根本没时间自己去玩，这是一个很简单的逻辑，对吧？
关于 Bug 反馈与背后的闲言碎语 有些人下了补丁，发现里头有些边角料或者短信文本没汉化，第一时间不是来向我反馈，而是跑到某些圈子的大群里疯狂地吐槽我、阴阳怪气我。这究竟是何意味啊？哈哈。
每个游戏作者的代码习惯千奇百怪。像那种常见的短信文本，很多是缩写格式，很难提取，就算提取了也要改源代码才能显示汉化。我不自己打一遍通关，根本遇不到这些问题。
AI 汉化本来就会有幻觉、错译、中英夹杂。 我在每篇博文的落谦酱便利贴里白纸黑字写得清清楚楚：如果介意请勿游玩。我已经非常诚恳、仁至义尽了。为了解决瑕疵，我还专门写脚本去提取原文本修复 Bug，给有官中的游戏做完整 Mod。
我甚至在补丁右上角特意留了 GitHub 的 Logo，就是为了方便大家联系我反馈。结果有人嫌弃，问能不能把 Logo 删掉？他妈的删了你怎么向我反馈问题？既然有自己修 Bug 的能力，干嘛还用我的补丁？何必要让我多此一举？如果嫌弃，马老师的汉化教程在那摆着，自己花十几块钱跑个 AI 不好吗？大家皆大欢喜。
说到底，我真不欠你们什么，做这些只是帮一把有需要的水友而已。背后吐槽真的挺没意思的，你提一嘴，我有空肯定会更新。
关于造谣与“喝茶” 前阵子我 B 站号被抬走，最离谱的事情来了：居然有人造谣我进去喝茶了。
甚至还搞出了有图有真相，把我的 CPU 都干烧了，我都不知道那是真有人进去了还是拿 GPT 生成的。这又是何意味啊？我自问没惹你们，也没得罪你们。
关于“倒狗”与接官中的节奏 如果非要说得罪，可能就是以前那几档子事。
2024 年，那时候还没 Deepseek，只有 ChatGPT，某宝买 Token 又贵质量又一般。我在音符发图文时，有水友提议大家一起凑点费用跑 AI。结果呢？我直接被打上了“倒狗”的标签。合着我盗我自己的？ 仅仅因为我跑完 AI 整理了个游戏表格，恰好有圈内大佬做的官中，我就成了众矢之的。我很不理解，你们圈内大佬靠充电进群、拿谷歌精翻设门槛的比比皆是，我却因此被声讨。行，你们青出于蓝，我解散、我道歉。
这就是为什么我现在宁愿花大把时间自己修 Bug，都不愿意把补丁整体打包丢进爱发电里。我怕了，怕又被拿来阴阳怪气，怕又被打上倒狗标签。说真的，再来一次我直接删库跑路。
更难绷的是，有人贴脸开大阴阳怪气：“给你百八十块，能不能拉我进群？” 有钱不赚王八蛋，我也想开群，但我没那个精力纯靠手搓翻译。我英语就简单口语水平，润色几句污言秽语就开始头痛，平时也就爱玩点烂梗。
这也牵扯到之前《异世界天堂》的节奏了。当时为了午夜直播过审，我仿照《凡人修仙传》搞了点文绉绉的古言翻译加烂梗。确实是当局者迷，但你觉得不合适大可跟我反馈，我跑个正常文风的版本不就完了？特别简单的事，何必咄咄逼人？甚至质问我：“你接官中为什么不向我们打报告？凭什么接官中？我们都有圈子了，何需你一个外人？”
行，我推掉官中，并且从那之后，关于官中的事我再也没碰过。 但有一句话我至今记得，那些串子说：“你不翻，有的是人翻。”
我只能说，牛逼。你们可以不尊重我一个整活的 AI 汉化，但至少得尊重你们圈内认真花时间翻译的大佬吧。对着别人的心血来一句你不翻有的是人翻，我只能说牛逼！

The Headmaster [v0.17.3.2] [Altos and Herdone] Overview 剧情概要 In the not too distant future, on a small island nation, a crisis has arisen. The number of students graduating from school has fallen sharply and university places are going unfilled. Faced with the prospect of mass unemployment and potential economic disaster the government is forced to introduce emergency measures. All students over eighteen who failed or were expelled from school are to be forced back into education at a number of special facilities. Spoiler: More In The Headmaster you play an expert in young adult psychology with some unique ideas about how to tackle the crisis. After a demonstration of your theories at a teachers conference you are approached by the agent of a mysterious organisation. He invites you to interview for the position of headmaster (principal) at one of the newly founded schools for over eighteen year olds. Keen to prove yourself and your theories you gladly accept. Using your unique disciplinary methods you must turn a whole school of delinquent young women into hard working and obedient students. Things will not be easy for you. A new material, developed by a group of scientists, possesses not only extraordinary strength, hyper-elasticity, and energy-saving properties, but also a unique, or rather exceptional, ability to self-repair. This capability turned the material into a regenerative pill, allowing people with limited abilities to become fully functional humans, while also making them stronger, smarter, and even extending their lifespan. Spoiler: More However, fearing the consequences of such power, the scientists decide to destroy the records, reports, and everything related to their research. They scattered, each going their own way. But as is often the case, someone found the remnants of this work. Ignoring the dangers, they decided to complete it, which eventually led to the formation of a globally banned terrorist organization called “Masquerade.” In response, leaders of major corporations launched a large-scale operation to eliminate the individual responsible and eradicate everything related to the research. You are a former soldier, unable to bear the guilt of the atrocities committed during the operation. You retreat to a remote location on the edge of the world, a small town cut off from the rest of civilization, where you planned to live a peaceful life with your wife and children, far removed from all the troubles of the past. But, as often happens, things do not go according to plan. One day, when your wife goes on a business trip to a certain research institute, she suddenly stops contacting you. In an attempt to find out what happened, you embark on a journey. Days, weeks, months, and years pass… Eventually, you come to terms with the fact that you may never see your wife again, burying all your emotions deep inside. 2023-02-17 Changelog 更新日志 It has been almost 1 year since we released VIRTUES v16. Back then we really thought v16 would be the last major update of VIRTUES. We used 10 weeks to create an insane amount of content (700+ new pictures and 70+ animated scenes) and thought “this is it, we’ve put a good end to the journey of VIRTUES. It is not a perfect end, there are regrets, but it is still a good end. We made it. We finish our first project instead of abandoning it halfway. There may be a v17 at some point in the future, but it will be a minor update, you know, like a DLC kind of stuff.” I kept this thought even until last December, until we really began to develop this v17 update. But as soon as I re-entered the world of VIRTUES, I changed my mind. I realized there were still so many things I want to tell, so many scenes I want to make for those girls, the girls that used to be a big part of my life for more than 2 years. Thus I changed my plan, and I changed it again and again during the last two months. More and more scenes were added, more and more lines were written, and less and less time I slept every day. And in the end, this update became so big that we couldn’t even imagine it. It became even bigger than v16. It has more than 900+ new pictures and 70+ animated scenes, with the greatest amount of text. V17 is the last major update of VIRTUES. It is the biggest update we’ve ever made, and maybe the lewdest one as well. Still, it is not a perfect end and there are regrets, but we have done our best and we hope you will enjoy our hard work. I will write a post as the final summary of the journey of VIRTUES in a few days. As for now, let’s just take a brief look at what’s new in the update: Irene’s solo ending The silver kitten finally got her solo ending. Her ending contains two long branches, and each of them leads to a unique happy end. You will help this girl solve her confusion and decide the path of her future. Elisa’s solo ending Just like her little daughter, this blonde milf’s solo ending also contains two long branches. This poor lady was deeply wounded from her previous marriage and she really needs you to take her away from the curse from her past. The afterstory of your harem There will be 4 major parts of your harem’s afterstory: Vera’s college dream, Uno’s real family, Senning’s daily life after her mother left the country, and the Shinyrost mother&daughter’s male worship. Each of them contains a tremendous amount of harem scenes. Developer（入正地址） Patreon Discord Itch.io

Shunned by most of his meta-gifted peers, MC finds himself a hapless virgin on the lower rung of his school’s social ladder, with only a few misfit friends by his side. When MC is targeted and violently attacked for reasons unknown to him, The Sisterhood – a government-backed team of celebrity superheroines and sex icons - comes to his aid. While under their care, The Sisterhood immediately recognize his worth and hidden charms. MC soon finds himself juggling his school life, his suddenly blossoming relationships with the women he keeps close, his curious involvement with The Sisterhood and one big secret that could determine whether this is the origin story of a hero, or a villain. Mayfly [v0.2 Reset] [JasonTon] Overview 游戏概述 “The city’s sewers stink of blood and rust. Portraits of the wealthy and powerful line the streets, attempting to cover up the heinous crimes they’ve committed.”
“Is it truly brightness and warmth that meets you after suffering?” your life.
Spoiler The story is set in the city of Devon, the country’s only mega city. Plagued by a glaring wealth gap, Devon eventually divided into the Uppercity, where company execs and corpos live amidst opulence and luxury, and the Undercity, where factory workers and gangsters, including triads, dwell.
A decade ago, a phenomenon of unknown origin resulted in the sudden emergence of superpowers among individuals in and around the city, primarily among teenagers. However, this unexpected development presented a formidable challenge for the government, as these superpowered individuals started to engage in criminal activities. In particular, they targeted the Uppercity due to deep-rooted inequality, resorting to acts such as kidnapping and murder of the wealthy.
To tackle the rising crime rates, the government is compelled to implement two bills: the Vigilante Act and the Superpowers Act. The former empowers selected individuals with superpowers to go beyond traditional law enforcement measures to combat criminals, while the latter treats superpowered individuals differently from regular humans, eliminating age restrictions and establishing dedicated prisons for them.
Over time, superpowered crime in Devon steadily decreased thanks to the state-funded Vigilantes who are entrusted with the task of upholding justice. However, as the Vigilante force expanded, the balance started to shift as some Vigilantes with concealed motives became a new source of instability in the city. Additionally, after the initial surge of superpowers, no new superpowers have emerged in Devon. This results in a growing public demand for the abolition of the Vigilante Bill, and a change in public perception of Vigilantes from once-revered heroes to a more critical stance.
In such a setting, where you are a member of the Vigilantes, are you truly willing to let others dictate your fate? I believe the answer is unequivocally “Never.” Every decision you make, whether significant or seemingly inconsequential, has the potential to impact the relationships and alliances you form during your journey.
Is it to live fleetingly like a mayfly in this superficially vibrant city, or to leave a lasting legacy as a legend in the streets?
“The power to determine your destiny rests in your hands.”
